competitors.name: Exness
competitors.takeaway: Publishing product-led utility pages (calculator, converter, reviews), but only 38 organic keywords in Japan.

competitors.name: Monex
competitors.takeaway: Wins market-information demand (futures guides, economic calendar). Only the futures and calendar overlap is relevant for XM.

competitors.name: Rakuten Securities
competitors.takeaway: Dominates Nikkei futures and market pages (11.8K clicks on 日経平均先物). The benchmark for a market hub.

competitors.name: KaigaiFX
competitors.takeaway: Review site with a dedicated XM page. It gets about 750 clicks a month on XM brand terms.

competitors.name: FXSignup
competitors.takeaway: Affiliate site ranking #2 for 'xm' (13K clicks). Shares 31% of its keywords with XM (Ahrefs). Check which brokers it promotes.

opportunities.title: Stop campaign pages ranking for unrelated queries
opportunities.summary: The gold deposit bonus campaign pages are the top-ranking XM page for 88 keywords and about 9.4K estimated clicks (4.4% of XM organic clicks). Many are other companies' logins or product searches the page cannot answer.
evidence: /jp/landing/gold-deposit-bonus and its tracking variants: 88 keywords, 9.4K estimated clicks (Oct 2026).
Includes トレーディングビュー (992 clicks), 楽天証券 (372), SBI新生銀行 初回ログイン (265) and au カブコム証券 ログイン (254).
The contact page showed the same pattern in Aug (日経225, 606 clicks). That query is gone, but the page still ranks for an unrelated one (郵便局の休日, 312 clicks in Oct).
opportunities.action: Check in Search Console which queries the campaign URLs rank for. Add noindex or a canonical on the tracking variants, and send TradingView and platform queries to dedicated pages (see OPP-06).
opportunities.validation: The campaign pages' keyword count falls, clicks to the MT5 and TradingView pages rise, and bonus-related clicks do not drop.

opportunities.title: Reclaim broken backlinks to /jp/faq and /jp/jp
opportunities.summary: High-authority sites link to XM URLs that now return errors, so the link value is lost.
evidence: Broken backlinks from DR 93 sources (ameblo.jp, note.com) point at /jp/faq.
/jp/jp is also linked from high-DR sources and is broken.
opportunities.action: Redirect the broken URLs (301) to the closest live pages such as the help centre and Japan homepage, then re-run the broken-backlinks report.
opportunities.validation: Broken backlink count in Ahrefs falls; referring-domain value to the target pages rises. No registrations are modelled for this item.

opportunities.title: Optimise the MT5 and MT4 download pages (positions 9 and 10)
opportunities.summary: People searching for trading platforms are close to opening an account, and XM already ranks just off the top results.
evidence: mt4ダウンロード: 3.4K searches, XM ranks #9; xmスプレッド: 1K searches, #6.
xm mt4 ダウンロード: position 1, 678 estimated clicks, difficulty 35 (Oct 2026). Defend it.
mt5 ranks #8 and mt5 ダウンロード #5, but together they send under 150 clicks.
opportunities.action: Refresh titles, headings and content on /jp/mt5 and /jp/mt4, add internal links from high-traffic pages, and place a registration call to action next to the download.
opportunities.validation: Position and clicks for the three keywords in Search Console; registration starts from both pages.

opportunities.title: Connect Search Console and registration events
opportunities.summary: Today the tool can only show estimated clicks. Without first-party data we cannot tell which pages and markets produce registrations.
evidence: Google Search Console is not connected.
Registration start and completion events are not collected.
opportunities.action: Connect Search Console for xmtrading.com, then add events for registration start and completion that carry the landing page and traffic source.
opportunities.validation: This tool shows measured clicks, registration starts and completions per landing page and market.

opportunities.title: Publish an XM portal redesign and migration guide
opportunities.summary: Questions about the new portal peaked after the change and a third-party site answered them. Demand has since faded, so this mostly protects existing customers.
evidence: In Aug, KaigaiFX ranked for 'xm インターフェースが変わった' (136 clicks). The query is not in the Oct data.
KaigaiFX's portal explainer now gets about 2 clicks a month.
No official XM page answering this is in the top-40 pages.
opportunities.action: Publish a change log covering wallet, login and MT4/MT5 migration, and link it from the login page.
opportunities.validation: Clicks to the guide, drop in competitor clicks for the redesign queries, support tickets on the same topics. Mostly protects existing customers, not new registrations.

opportunities.title: Create a TradingView compatibility guide
opportunities.summary: 91K monthly searches for TradingView and no dedicated XM page ranks. The traffic XM gets lands on a gold campaign page.
evidence: トレーディングビュー: 91.1K searches, 992 estimated clicks, no ranking XM page (Oct 2026).
None of the five tracked competitors capture this query, so XM could be the first official answer.
opportunities.action: Create an official guide covering compatibility, setup and limitations, with a registration call to action.
opportunities.validation: Position and clicks for トレーディングビュー; registration starts from the guide.

opportunities.title: Build a Nikkei 225 and futures market hub
opportunities.summary: The largest demand pool in the data. Informational visitors convert slowly, so this builds reach rather than quick registrations.
evidence: 日経平均先物: 739K searches (Oct 2026). XM does not appear in the ranking data.
Rakuten captures 11.8K clicks and Monex 7.7K clicks on it, both at position 5.
opportunities.action: Build a durable hub page for Nikkei 225 and futures with market context and a path into registration. Pair it with OPP-01.
opportunities.validation: Position and clicks for the hub's keyword cluster; share of non-brand clicks (now 10.6%).

opportunities.title: Consolidate a withdrawal timing and status guide
opportunities.summary: Withdrawal questions affect trust, which affects registration. XM has partial coverage spread across support articles, and measured demand is small.
evidence: 海外fx 出金 最新情報 has no measurable search volume in Oct 2026.
KaigaiFX's XM withdrawal pages get almost no clicks.
An XM FXPlus article on bank withdrawal timing gets 583 estimated clicks.
opportunities.action: Merge the support content into one canonical, regularly updated guide.
opportunities.validation: Clicks and position for withdrawal queries; support contacts on the topic.

opportunities.title: Make XM's economic calendar rank
opportunities.summary: Monex gets large organic traffic from its calendar page. XM already has a calendar on FXPlus, but it barely ranks.
evidence: Monex's economic indicator calendar page: about 28.9K estimated organic clicks (Oct 2026).
XM's FXPlus calendar ranks #12 for 指標発表 with no measurable clicks.
opportunities.action: Check that the FXPlus calendar is indexable and answers the query, then strengthen it or consolidate it into one Japan calendar page.
opportunities.validation: Position for 指標発表 and 経済指標, clicks to the page, and registration starts from it.

opportunities.title: Decide a comparison content strategy for 海外fx おすすめ
opportunities.summary: The search closest to a registration decision. It is also competitive and the most sensitive for compliance.
evidence: 海外fx おすすめ: 3.3K searches, difficulty 25 (Oct 2026). XM does not appear in the ranking data.
fxsignup.com ranks #3 (200 clicks) and KaigaiFX #8 (9 clicks).
opportunities.action: Agree with Compliance what XM may publish before any page is built.
opportunities.validation: A written content policy; position and clicks for the keyword once a page exists.

opportunities.title: Review affiliate sites ranking for XM terms
opportunities.summary: Affiliate and review sites capture about 20K estimated monthly clicks on searches for XM itself, and may promote competitors.
evidence: fxsignup.com ranks #2 for xm (13.0K estimated clicks) and xmtrading (3.0K), and #1 for xm ログイン (4.3K).
KaigaiFX's /details/xm page gets about 750 clicks on xm and xmtrading (#6 and #8).
fxsignup.com shares 1,293 keywords with XM (31% of its keywords).
opportunities.action: Map which affiliate sites rank for XM brand and platform queries, which brokers they promote, and check partner compliance.
opportunities.validation: A reviewed list of sites with actions per site.

opportunities.title: Create a trust and verification hub
opportunities.summary: Competitors publish review pages. XM's regulation and 'who we are' pages exist but are separate.
evidence: XM's regulation and who-we-are pages exist separately.
Exness has only 38 organic keywords in Japan, so the pressure is limited here.
opportunities.action: Draft a compliant hub linking regulation, security and policies.
opportunities.validation: Clicks to the hub; registration rate of visitors who viewed it, once events exist.

opportunities.title: Assess calculator and currency converter tools
opportunities.summary: Exness launched two utility pages. XM has an all-in-one calculator but no converter was detected.
opportunities.action: Decide whether to extend the existing calculator or add a converter.

notPursuing.title: cTrader chart tutorials
notPursuing.reason: XM offers MT4, MT5 and TraderPro, not cTrader. It is KaigaiFX's strongest new page, but we should not create content unless product support changes.

notPursuing.title: NISA and mutual-fund guides
notPursuing.reason: Very high demand (for example オルカン チャート 684K, 子供NISA 283K), but outside the leveraged-trading proposition. High volume would bring the wrong intent.
